script: An entire army stood ready to invade France, and it was made of rubber. In 1944, General Patton commanded a massive force stationed across from Calais, tanks lined up, radio traffic buzzing constantly. Hitler kept his best divisions waiting there for weeks. But the tanks were inflatable rubber decoys, and the radio chatter was faked by a handful of operators. The real invasion landed at Normandy while Hitler's strongest reserves sat guarding an empty beach against a phantom army. By the time Germany realized the truth, the real invasion had already broken through. An entire army fooled Hitler for weeks, and it was made of rubber.

description:
